repository.documentation_commit_sha_note: The documentation commit SHA is reported in the final Codex handoff and remote verification; a commit cannot contain its own SHA without changing that SHA.

discovery.existing_decision_calendar: DecisionCalendarEntryV2 persistence and index validation already existed.
discovery.existing_outcome_contract: MaturedOutcomeV2 (MATURED_OUTCOME_V2_V3), its validators, and index_matured_outcome already existed and remain authoritative.
existing_evidence: CandidateActionV2 exact horizon and frozen action identity
action-critic maturity linking to an existing validated outcome
discovery.missing_seam: No bounded controller-owned maturity coordinator, restart checkpoint, per-decision maturity status, or continuous decision-calendar-to-outcome production path was present.
discovery.reviewed_checkpoints: No Session 033 or newer reviewed checkpoint or outcome producer was found on another branch at preflight.

lifecycle.pending: A decision remains PENDING until its exact persisted CandidateActionV2 horizon is reached.
lifecycle.maturable: After the exact horizon, the coordinator attempts resolution immediately. The report counts unresolved, horizon-elapsed items as maturable backlog; no separate outcome label is emitted.
lifecycle.matured: Only a complete, causal, unambiguous evidence chain accepted by the existing validators is indexed as MaturedOutcomeV2.
lifecycle.unresolved: Missing or ambiguous evidence is retained as an append-only OutcomeMaturityStatusV1 and may be retried. It never becomes zero payoff or zero cost.
lifecycle.censored: An exact expiry record can produce a value-free CENSORED MaturedOutcomeV2 after its declared horizon.
lifecycle.unsupported: No declared candidate/horizon or unsupported target is explicitly retained as lifecycle status without inventing a target.

implementation.outcome_schema: Existing MaturedOutcomeV2 and index_matured_outcome reused without validator relaxation.
implementation.availability: Decision, action, diagnostic, replay, actual-close, cost, funding, and source evidence identities are checked and admitted only at their available_at_ns. Outcome availability is no earlier than the resolution time or any required evidence; outcome maturity is no earlier than horizon completion.

provenance.actual: Requires the exact frozen action, typed actual closed-position source, reconciled execution and account-cash sources, exact action-position/economics observations, quantity/state agreement, and the existing actual binding validator.
provenance.simulated: Uses only an existing accepted PolicyPayoffV2/ReplayPathV2 chain and the current payoff validator. No replay is generated or improved by S33.
provenance.counterfactual: Uses only existing replay evidence for declared action outcomes or an exact predeclared diagnostic target. Diagnostic outcomes carry no executable fill or USDT payoff.

execution_and_cost_rules.no_fill: Only an exact supported PolicyPayoffV2 or actual binding can establish NO_FILL; absent fill evidence remains unresolved.
execution_and_cost_rules.partial_fill: Uses the exact supported filled quantity and does not score the unfilled remainder.
execution_and_cost_rules.full_fill: Must equal exact requested quantity under existing validators.
execution_and_cost_rules.fees: Required typed fee evidence and recorded fee rows are counted once; missing fee evidence prevents monetary maturity.
execution_and_cost_rules.funding: A cutoff-known funding schedule and exact settlement coverage are required where applicable; sign is preserved and net payoff is gross minus fees plus funding.
execution_and_cost_rules.mfe_mae: Absent because no qualifying exact extrema evidence source exists; no extrema are reconstructed.

decision_calendar_classes.selected: Retained; terminal executable labels require exact supported action evidence.
decision_calendar_classes.unselected: Retained; only an exact predeclared diagnostic/counterfactual target can produce a value label.
decision_calendar_classes.rejected: Retained with original rejection identity; no action fill is fabricated.
decision_calendar_classes.no_candidate: Retained as unsupported when there is no exact declared candidate horizon.
decision_calendar_classes.selection_not_estimable: Retained with original selection state and explicit lifecycle status.
decision_calendar_classes.admission_no_trade: Original admission state is copied; any monetary result requires existing supported replay/actual evidence.
decision_calendar_classes.admission_not_estimable: Original admission state is copied; any monetary result requires existing supported replay/actual evidence.
decision_calendar_classes.expired: Retained; exact expiry evidence may produce value-free CENSORED outcome.
decision_calendar_classes.unresolved: Retained in append-only lifecycle status; no interim label is indexed.
decision_calendar_classes.censored: Retained with exact expiry evidence and no monetary value.
decision_calendar_classes.non_executable_diagnostic: Uses the existing diagnostic target fields only; never coerced into trading P&L.

resource_bounds.backlog_metrics: Per bounded page: pending, maturable, matured, unresolved, censored, unsupported, bound exhaustion, oldest pending/maturable age, and read counts. These are telemetry, not a second source of truth.

restart_and_persistence.cursor: Immutable versioned OutcomeMaturityCheckpointV1 with generation and stable descending keyset cursor.
restart_and_persistence.status: Append-only OutcomeMaturityStatusV1; no historical evidence is edited.
restart_and_persistence.duplicate_prevention: Exact bounded outcome lookup per decision. Existing typed outcomes are revalidated through index_matured_outcome before being treated as complete.
restart_and_persistence.starvation: Every bounded page is fully attempted before cursor advance; deterministic traversal wraps so older entries are eventually reached.
restart_and_persistence.writer: The existing atlas-ops OpsRepository supplied by OpsSupervisorV2 is the only writer. No separate connection, daemon, or worker was added.
restart_and_persistence.decision_isolation: Maintenance runs after cycle and decision receipts are indexed. Sanitized failures cannot alter sealed receipts or decision output.

implementation.critic_boundary: The hidden critic remains downstream and zero authority. The existing linker accepts only a validated available MaturedOutcomeV2 and cannot create a label.

maturity_coordinator.focused_result: 8 passed during development; main-agent integration adjusted the cycle bound to process every inspected decision.
